authorization: User explicitly redirects work to first WTC1 facade contact. This creates a bounded non-eroding numerical pilot; the V9M physical fracture/global qualification gates are not relaxed or declared passed.

speed.source: V8S video-derived AA11 reference, NIST NCSTAR 1-2B Table 7-3; not estimated from Evidence1/2

facade.classification: Representative nominal geometry inherited from V8V, not exact panel-124 plate schedule; shared nodes stand for perfect joints; upper/lower ends fixed; no gravity prestress

box.classification: Entire geometry and uniform skin are explicit generic hollow wing-section surrogate hypotheses, NOT sourced Boeing spars, ribs, skin, sweep or structural resistance. No fuel, engine, fuselage or attachment mass. Mass follows geometry and density, never fitted to desired penetration.

aluminum.classification: Generic isotropic aluminum hypothesis inherited from V8V cowling, NOT identified 2024/7075 production card. No strain-rate uplift or fracture fit.

constitutive.flag_meaning: Conservative diagnostic marker for need of constitutive review; NOT an experimentally measured fracture strain and NOT physical validation below threshold.

contact.type: TYPE7 one-way projectile nodes to facade segments
contact.limitation: Early contact diagnostic only; folded self-intersecting or edge-dominated late states must not be promoted as physical results.

cases.role: Additional diagnostic refinement after original 50-to-25 mm gate failed; original failure retained, same 10 percent criterion

sources.role: Cached AA11 speed and mass ledger, no whole-plane mass allocated to this box
Constitutive methodology, alloy families, nominal panel construction; not a source for surrogate box dimensions
